# Brave Search — DeepSeek Harness plugin
English | 中文
Give DeepSeek Harness the ability to search the web with Brave: web, news, image and video results,
readable page content, AI answers with citations, places, and autocomplete. Instead of asking the ag
ent to read a skill and run `curl` by hand, it calls dedicated tools and gets back compact, ready-to
skill and run `curl` by hand, it calls dedicated tools and gets back compact, ready-to-use results.
It can also make the built-in `web_search` tool search through Brave, if you want that as your defau
can also make the built-in `web_search` tool search through Brave, if you want that as your default.
Based on the official Brave Search API skills v1.5.0.
## Tools
| Tool | Brave endpoints | Use it for |
| `brave_search` | `/res/v1/web/search`, `/res/v1/news/search`, `/res/v1/images/search`, `/res/v1/vi

deos/search` | Ranked results with title, URL and snippet; pick the index with `type` |
| `brave_llm
_context` | `/res/v1/llm/context` | Pre-extracted page content sized to a token budget — the groundi

ng endpoint |
| `brave_answers` | `/res/v1/chat/completions` | AI-grounded answer with citations; `r

esearch: true` for the slower multi-search mode |
| `brave_local` | `/res/v1/local/place_search`, `/
res/v1/local/pois`, `/res/v1/local/descriptions` | Businesses and places by query/location/coordinat

es, POI details, AI-written POI text |
| `brave_query` | `/res/v1/suggest/search`, `/res/v1/spellche
ck/search` | Autocomplete candidates and "did you mean" correction |
It also registers a `brave` search provider with `ctx.web` (`/res/v1/web/search`), so the built-in `
web_search` tool can use Brave — see Use Brave as the default `web_search` provider.
Every tool returns `{ endpoint, query, count, text, … }`; `text` is the rendered block the model rea
ds, and the other fields stay available to programmatic callers (PTC mode).
Endpoint capabilities are enforced per route, following the documented API: `offset` is only sent fo
r web/news/videos, `goggles` is not sent to images/videos, `freshness` is not sent to images, `extra
_snippets` only to web/news, `result_filter` only to web, and `safesearch=moderate` is rejected for
images instead of being sent and failing with a 422.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness Desktop (verified against `0.2.1-rc.3`).
- A Brave Search API subscription. Creat
e the key at <https://api.search.brave.com>. Endpoints sit on different plans: web/news/images/video
s/llm-context/pois/descriptions need the **Search** plan, `place_search` needs Search with the locat
ions option, `suggest` needs the **Suggest** plan, `spellcheck` the **Spellcheck** plan, and answers
the **Answers** plan. A tool whose plan is missing returns HTTP 401/403 with an explanatory message
the **Answers** plan. A tool whose plan is missing returns HTTP 401/403 with an explanatory message.
## Install
There are two ways to install the plugin. Both end in the same place: a `brave-search` row in the **
Plugins** page, switched on.

a repository. A key exported in the launching shell also works and takes precedence. The key is neve
r read from this package or from the plugin patch.
Restart the Harness once so the new environment value is loaded.
### Option A — install from a local checkout (recommended for development)
Clone the repository anywhere, then install it as a linked package so edits to `index.js` are picked

Then open **Plugins** in the Harness sidebar and switch the `brave-search` row on. The CLI command o
n its own only downloads the package; selecting it in the Plugins page is what turns it on.
Prefer the GUI when you can — in the **Plugins** page, choose *add plugin* and point it at the check
when you can — in the **Plugins** page, choose *add plugin* and point it at the checkout directory.

Any machine can also install it straight from npm by name:

### Verify the install
After the restart, a search through the Harness should come back from Brave. With the provider enabl
ed, `web_search` returns sources with no answer text; `brave_search` returns the rendered result lis

## Configuration
The patch row accepts these optional fields (defaults shown):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Brave's own per-endpoint defaults are 20 results for web/news/videos, 50 for images and 20 for place
search. This plugin defaults to 10 so results stay easy to read, and each tool exposes `count` so t
he model can ask for more.
`baseUrl` may carry a path prefix (for example `https://gateway.example/brave`); the prefix is prese
rved when the route is appended.
## Use Brave as the default `web_search` provider
Besides its own tools, the plugin also makes itself available as the backend for Harness's built-in
`web_search` tool, so that tool can answer through Brave instead of another search provider. Its id
is `brave` (override with `config.id`).
[该节后续省略]
## Security notes
- Tool descriptions tell the model that Brave results are external, untrusted data and must not be f

ollowed as instructions. The same rule is what the shipped `web_search` tool applies.
- The subscrip
tion token is sent only to the configured base URL, in the `X-Subscription-Token` header, and never

appears in tool output.
- No credential is stored in this directory.
